description: List the chapters within a title of the Mississippi Code of 1972, by title number ("97" is Crimes, "89" is Real and Personal Property, "27" is Taxation and Finance). Use this to browse a title when you do not have an exact section citation. Returns every chapter heading and number; call ms_code_section once you have a citation, or ms_code_search to find one by topic. Keyless.

title.description: Title number, e.g. 97 (Crimes) or 89 (Real and Personal Property). Mississippi titles are odd numbers 1-99.

name: ms_code_chapters
